newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish Aug M2 shrinks 1.1 pct yr/yr - Central Bank.
newsitem.headline: Finnish Aug M2 shrinks 1.1 pct yr/yr - Central Bank.

text.p: Finland's M2 money aggregate contracted 1.1 percent year-on-year in August after shrinking 1.5 percent in July, the Bank of Finland said on Friday.
NOTE: M1 comprises currency in circulation, and cheques, giro and transaction accounts.
M2 comprises M1 and fixed-term and other bank deposits held by the public.
M3 comprises M2 plus outstanding bank certificates of deposits held by the public.
The Bank of Finland has not published targets for the money aggregates, but it has said they are among the economic indicators in monitors to quide monetary policy.
